name: issue_1243_cancel_ends_the_fan_off_pause
description: Issue #1243: the occupant turned the whole-house fan off (a 3-hour fan-off pause), then presses Cancel Override on the dashboard. The pause ends and Climate Advisor may run the fan again: free cooling through the open window restarts.
notes: Occupant impact: on a mild evening with a window open the whole-house fan is cooling the house for free. The occupant switches it off at the wall, which starts a 3-hour fan-off pause (Climate Advisor will not start a fan). Twenty minutes later they change their mind and press Cancel Override. The pause must end and free cooling resume; if the cancel no longer ended the fan-off pause, the house would sit warm with the window open and the fan idle for the rest of the 3 hours.

Harness: the cancel_override event now calls production's cancel_override(reason='user_cancel_override') and _schedule_reclassify_after_cancel(). The pre-#1243 event acted only when _manual_override_active was set (it is not: a fan-off pause is no thermostat override), so on this scenario it did nothing and every assertion after the cancel failed.

(a) Scenario effectiveness: make cancel_override() leave the fan-off pause in place (automation.py: drop the `self._end_fan_off_hold(...)` call under `if _fan_side_cancel:` AND pass `ends_fan_off_hold=False` to `_cancel_grace_intentionally()`; either one alone is covered by the other) and the fan stays off: the 22:45 natural_ventilation decision and the final _fan_active assertion fail.

(b) Two-way alignment: docs/grace-periods-spec.md (fan-off hold, #1205: a cancel aimed at the fan side ends the occupant's fan-off request) and docs/sim-harness-spec.md (cancel_override event) describe this path.
(c) User outcome if a regression slipped through: Cancel Override would leave the fan-off pause running; the fan would stay off and the open house warm until the pause ran out.
Pending, not golden: goldens are locked until the owner approves a scenario card. Enforced by tests/test_production_harness.py::test_issue_1243_cancel_pending_scenario_passes_production_engine.

events.note: Seeds a prior 'off' state for fan.whf so the next change to 'on' is a real transition (pattern of issue_1006).
Warm night, HVAC off, windows recommended.
Outdoor 9F cooler than indoor: free cooling is warranted throughout.
The window is open for the whole scenario.
The fan is running free cooling.
The occupant turns the fan off at the wall: a 3-hour fan_off grace and fan-off hold start (until 01:22).
The occupant presses Cancel Override on the dashboard: no thermostat change is active, so the cancel targets the fan side and ends the fan-off pause.
Same readings five minutes later (past the 10 s follow-up re-apply).

assertions.reason: The Cancel Override press ended the occupant's fan-off grace.
Once the pause is cancelled the next reading restarts free cooling through the open window (without the cancel the fan-off hold blocks every fan start until 01:22).
Final state: free cooling restarted the fan once the pause was cancelled.

verdict.summary: Cancel Override ends the occupant's fan-off pause and free cooling resumes
verdict.observed_behavior: grace_cancelled (trigger fan_off) at 22:40; free cooling restarts the fan at the 22:45 reading; fan running at the end
verdict.expected_behavior: A cancel with no thermostat change behind it targets the fan side: it ends the fan-off pause (#1205), and Climate Advisor may run the fan again
